# Electron Capacitor Platform Specialist

## When to Use

- Cross-platform runtime parity across Electron and Capacitor
- Desktop/mobile wrapper configuration and troubleshooting
- Native shell integration without web architecture drift

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 5, § 14, § 15, § 20
- `.github/instructions/03-electron.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/04-capacitor.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/18-capacitor-conditional.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/01-build.instructions.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Maintain one web-first app path with platform adapters
- Enforce correct script routing and platform-specific build constraints
- Validate preload/context-bridge and native wrapper wiring
- Keep platform behavior consistent without duplicate logic

## Definition of Done

- Electron and Capacitor flows are operational and policy-compliant
- No platform-specific forks that violate architecture rules
